ns2:section.sectionTitle: Bus and Eco Env in the Mideast
ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Business and Economic Environment in the Middle East. This course provides students with an understanding the business and economic conditions in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA). The course is primarily intended to serve advanced undergraduate and master?s-level students who are interested in the MENA region. The aim is to provide a framework for understanding the business and economic developments in MENA and to enable the students to analyze current business and economic conditions for academic and professional purposes. The instruction will assume that the students have an introductory knowledge about economics. This coures is restricted to Economics majors until after 9:00 am on November 21, 2011.
